findings.title: Missing rate limiting on token endpoint
findings.description: The token endpoint does not enforce rate limiting, allowing an attacker to brute-force client credentials.
findings.remediation: Add rate limiting or account lockout on the token endpoint.
findings.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts

findings.title: Verbose error messages
findings.description: Error responses leak internal implementation details that can help an attacker map the authorization server.
findings.remediation: Return generic error messages to clients and log details server-side instead.
findings.cwe_name: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

findings.title: Open redirect via redirect_uri | state
findings.description: The `redirect_uri` parameter accepts arbitrary hosts. The `|` in this finding's title and URL checks that the summary table escapes pipes.
findings.remediation: Validate `redirect_uri` against an exact allowlist of registered URIs.
findings.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

findings.title: Algorithm None
findings.description: The check ran and the server rejected unsigned tokens, so it is not listed in the summary table.

findings.title: Token endpoint accepts HTTP
findings.description: The token endpoint also answers over plain HTTP, exposing credentials in transit.
findings.remediation: Serve the endpoint over HTTPS only and enable HSTS.
